column1: # The triggers of the Auto answer to "Write a plan first?" (scripts/plan-tier.sh). To change them, copy this file to
# the project's .claude/plan-triggers.tsv and edit that copy: a project's own file replaces this one whole.
# One trigger a line, three tab-separated columns: the tier (panel or none), a lowercase extended regex matched
# against the lowercased batch brief, and the name Auto prints. A panel trigger on any line picks Panel. No plan only
# when every item line of "## The issues" matches a none trigger. Anything else is Plan + judge.
